findings.finding: The guaranteed securities issuer is absent from each of the 18-row Exhibit 21 lists.
findings.consequence: Represent the guaranteed issuer as a distinct known entity with unknown ownership placement; do not merge Financial Company LLC with Holdings LLC.

findings.finding: 2022/2023 describe Series A Notes under the cited 2020-effective registration. 2024/2025 add possible debt securities and warrants under a cited 2023-effective registration.
findings.consequence: Keep both dated source descriptions. Do not infer issuance of warrants, retirement of old notes, or a same-context conflict.

findings.finding: The table supplies display nesting and organization jurisdictions, not ownership percentages or free-transfer rights.
